LanguageData.Raven_Weapon_GoheiRanged.label: [Raven] Ranged Gohei
LanguageData.Raven_Weapon_GoheiRanged.description: A traditional demon-warding ritual tool. After special enchanting, swinging it releases highly destructive Dai Onmyoudama. The wielder seems able to draw on its power to purify all evil.
LanguageData.Raven_Weapon_GoheiMelee.label: [Raven] Melee Gohei
LanguageData.Raven_Weapon_GoheiMelee.description: A demon-warding Gohei that appears unusually long compared to ordinary ones, with faint dark red bloodstains visible on the wooden handle. Legend has it that before spell cards were invented, this was the weapon of a young girl in a red-and-white shrine maiden outfit. Rather than firing flashy Danmaku, that shrine maiden seemed to prefer using this sturdy wooden stick to directly smash enemies' skulls. When swung, one can almost hear a young girl's crisp yet bone-chilling whisper: "It's time for youkai extermination~"
